h:
LTX 2.3 I2V + 音频工作流程，除了基本的精炼 Lora 之外，还允许上传多个 Loras

此工作流程相对于由用户 @ukr8b3g20 制作的原始版本进行了轻微修改，该版本已经非常用户友好

您可以在下面的链接中找到他们的工作流程 json 文件；

https://civitai.red/models/2431521/ltx-23-i2v-audiosync-simple-workflow-v4b-rtx-vsr

对于我的版本，我所做的只是移动一些东西，颜色代码并绕过主 ltx 节点子图中的两个“LTX2 Mem Eff Sage Attention Patch”节点，因为它一直给我一个错误，但一旦我绕过它们，它开始对我来说很好用，这个工作流程仍然很新鲜，所以我还没有太多时间用不同的 loras 来探索和测试它。

这基本上是相当于我的其他 Wan 2.2 初学者 I2V 工作流程的 LTX 2.3，它的制作是为了让您不必太担心精度和理解，您可以直接输入并生成！如果您需要基本的设置知识，请查看我的个人资料上有关 Wan 2.2 I2V 工作流程的说明。

此工作流程的基本视觉指南：

需要经常检查的一件事是确保音频持续时间和视频持续时间始终匹配，我发现当我生成多个视频时，ltx 视频持续时间设置有时会重置为其默认的 1024 x 700 尺寸，因此我建议始终仔细检查宽度和高度，以确保它是您实际设置的值！

o.en:
LTX 2.3 I2V + Audio Workflow that allows Multiple Loras to be uploaded in addition to the base distilled Lora

This workflow has been slightly modified from it's original version which was made by user @ukr8b3g20 which was already pretty user friendly

You can find their workflow json file in the link below;

https://civitai.red/models/2431521/ltx-23-i2v-audiosync-simple-workflow-v4b-rtx-vsr

For my version all I really did was just move some stuff around, color code and bypass those two "LTX2 Mem Eff Sage Attention Patch" nodes within the main ltx node subgraph because it kept giving me an error but once I bypassed them it began to work just fine for me, this workflow is still pretty fresh so I haven't had much time to explore and test it with different loras quite yet.

This is basically the LTX 2.3 equivalent to my other Wan 2.2 Beginner I2V workflow, it's made so that you don't have to worry so much about precision and understanding and you can just input and generate away! If you need basic setup knowledge check my instructions for my Wan 2.2 I2V Workflow on my profile.

Basic visual guide for this workflow:

One thing to always check is make sure that the audio duration and video duration are always matching and I've found that when I generate multiple videos the ltx video duration settings will sometimes reset to its default 1024 x 700 dimensions so I'd recommend always double checking the width & height to make sure it's what you actually set it to!
